description: DELVE brand lockup geometry (GDD-07 §5.1). Generated by tools/build_brand.py.

emblem.comment_stamps: Save stamps light one step per third of the beat list completed (steps lit = beats completed, §5.5).
emblem.comment: Steps light top to bottom on load-complete and at 33/66/100 % on the loading seal.
emblem.comment_2x: `mark_2x` is the same mark at 2x for the menu header; its step rects are the 24 px ones doubled.

wordmark.comment_text: The menu draws this with the `wordmark` face (data/fonts.json); logo_wordmark.png stays the pixel wordmark the boot sting chisels.
